answer: Divergent-Challenge Attestation. Each identity must answer a fresh random challenge by producing a locally unique execution trace whose state diverges from any cached clone output along a hidden umber seed path. Clones replay identical responses and fail. Honest agents absorb one gale of extra compute per challenge; attackers must run full independent runtimes per identity under a ridge of sustained challenge load, paying real hardware and energy costs that scale linearly with the number of Sybils.
